name: What is universal design in accessible kitchens?

mainEntity.name: What is universal design in accessible kitchens?

acceptedAnswer.text: Universal design in accessible kitchens means creating a space that is usable by all people, to the greatest extent possible, without the need for adaptation or specialized design. This approach goes beyond basic ADA compliance to consider a wide range of abilities and needs from the outset. Features like varied counter heights, clear floor spaces, lever handles, and easy-to-use controls benefit everyone, not just those with specific mobility challenges, promoting inclusivity and long-term usability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Universal design creates kitchens usable by everyone, regardless of ability, incorporating features that benefit all users without specialized adaptation.
